description: Five-into-one stereo signal switcher: one selected input pair reaches the outputs, and the change crossfades over about 40ms

params.text: Selects that stereo input as the one passed to the outputs, silencing the other four

inputs.text: The left side of one of the five stereo signals to choose between, reaching the left output when its channel is selected
The right side of one of the five stereo signals to choose between, reaching the right output when its channel is selected

outputs.text: Carries the left side of whichever stereo input is selected
Carries the right side of whichever stereo input is selected

menu: Poly output behavior — sets the channel count of the output from the widest connected input, with Max of active inputs, or from the selected input alone, with Selected input
Top label — a box in the menu where the name printed at the top of the panel is typed
Label colour — picks the colour of that top label
Get channel names from mappings — names each channel after the parameter that the matching PatchMaster radio button controls
